title: Yunos AI
tagline: Chatbot interface to interact your web3 wallet to Uniswap V4
description: Initially, Yunos was agentic swarm to manage and hedge your fund against the decline of token price. But then Yunos transformed into chatbot interface to help you interact your web3 wallet and Uniswap V4. It lets you to ask for a wallet connection, address, and balance with prompt rather than clicking manually through wallet.
how_its_made: We used Vercel AI SDK to customize chatbot interaction so that its well aware of web3 interactions. Then we used Uniswap V4 to create our own pool, then do a swap with that pool. We used both Viem and Wagmi to let user interact with their web3 wallet through our site. And we used Foundry to simulate and simplify the interaction with Uniswap V4.
